scope: Additional bounded closure requested during execution: what upstream flow must observations rule out to make FAST the unique regular evolutionary compressive family?

equations.r: (fU/fL)^2; the same radio pair determines density
equations.pressure: p1/rho1=2*kB*T/mp under the frozen R109 pure-H equal-temperature closure

FAST_certificate.method: Exact Bernstein coefficient bounds on an 8x4x8 cover plus analytic positive factors. Boundary eta=1, theta=0 and zero pressure remain degenerate; this certifies the open regular domain only.

SLOW_onset_certificate.construction: h=2 as one explicitly assumed sub-Alfvenic normal-field coordinate; b=((4-r)/(5*r))*(1+zeta)
SLOW_onset_certificate.method: Exact rational polynomial sign certificates over the complete radio-r interval, with an 8x4 cover. Positive entropy follows from the gas-Hugoniot limit and d(p2/b)/db>0 because W<0. Strict nonzero Bt and characteristic splitting require zeta>0.
SLOW_onset_certificate.meaning: Prove existence arbitrarily above the conditional ucrit without asserting a measured field, geometry or flow. This is an onset infimum, not a universal classification above the threshold.

finite_controls.source_cases: R110 central plus eight retained R109 radio/T corners
finite_controls.classification: Unchanged state-only classifier and already frozen R135 safeguards; guard-limited controls stay UNRESOLVED even where an exact open-domain theorem applies.

observational_comparison: Central threshold and conservative whole-source-domain threshold at frozen Vn. A future joint Vn/u1n interval must satisfy min(Vn-u1n)>max(wcrit), with shared dependencies retained. A bound on flow alone does not establish radio/EUV patch association or identify a shock surface.
